definitions.explanation: A word or set of words by which a person or thing is known.

examples.japanese: お{名前|なまえ}は{何|なん}ですか。
{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
{友達|ともだち}の{名前|なまえ}がなかなか{思|おも}い{出|だ}せなくて{困|こま}った。
examples.english: I couldn't remember my friend's name and it bothered me.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{名字|みょうじ}を{先|さき}に{言|い}って、その{後|あと}に{名前|なまえ}を{言|い}います。
examples.english: In Japan, you say your family name first, then your given name.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{生|う}まれたとき、いい{名前|なまえ}を{付|つ}けたいと{思|おも}って、{何日|なんにち}も{考|かんが}えてやっと{決|き}めた。
examples.english: When our child was born, we wanted to give a good name, so we thought about it for days before finally deciding.

notes:
{名前|なまえ} is the general word for name.

WORD FORMATION:
{名|な} (name) + {前|まえ} (front) – literally "the front name."

JAPANESE NAME ORDER:
Family name ({名字|みょうじ}/{苗字|みょうじ}) comes before given name ({下|した}の{名前|なまえ}).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{名前|なまえ}は?: What is your name? (polite)
- {名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to call someone's name
- {名前|なまえ}を{覚|おぼ}える: to remember a name
- {名前|なまえ}を{付|つ}ける: to give a name
- {名前|なまえ}{負|ま}け: not living up to one's name

NAME-RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {名字|みょうじ}/{苗字|みょうじ}: surname, family name
- {下|した}の{名前|なまえ}: first name, given name
- {本名|ほんみょう}: real name
- {偽名|ぎめい}: false name
- {名札|なふだ}: name tag
- {名刺|めいし}: business card

RELATED: {名|な} is the shorter literary form for "name."
